positions.as_written: Expect a knee with a partial posterior cruciate injury and an intact sheath to recover some restraint.
Treat healing in continuity and restored length as separate questions.
Protect the fat plane behind the capsule when working near the tibial attachment.
Avoid attributing altered position sense to laxity alone.
Treat the vascular anatomy as the determinant of healing capacity.
Preserve the synovial sheath wherever the plan allows.
Consider a trial of non operative treatment where the sheath is intact and the injury is partial, and read the anatomy as the reason rather than as a preference.
Assess the fat plane behind the capsule before any posterior work.
Document position sense separately from laxity.
